Calculate doses for drawn parameter sets

stochastic_doses.Rd

Calculates the doses of each sample with each parameter set and its drawn inputs.

Usage

stochastic_doses(
  samples,
  tissue,
  params,
  draws,
  inputs = NULL,
  known_warnings = character(0)
)

Arguments

samples

List of samples (input values of a single observation each), as for total_dose()

tissue

Tissue for which to calculate dose (default: "brain" or "body")

params

Parameter list, as returned by load_params()

draws

Drawn parameter sets, as returned by simulate_params()

inputs

Drawn inputs, as returned by simulate_inputs() (optional). If NULL, the inputs of the samples are used in every draw.

known_warnings

Warning messages that were already raised. Other warnings are raised once, with the number of times they occurred.

Value

Array of doses in mJ/kg/day: sample x draw x exposure source.
